results.llm_raw: {"say":"The cutter is fed only through L4, whose inputs come from the empty balancers L5/L6, so the cutter gets nothing and the hub receives nothing; give the cutter a direct ore source at its input cell.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B100","asCell":true},"facing":"top","machine":"miner","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"cutter's only feed runs back into the dead L5/L6 balancer chain; placing a miner on the cutter's input belt feeds it directly as the recipe requires (mine then cut)"}]}

{"say":"The factory has a cutter but nothing feeding it; route miner ore into the cutter and its cut half to the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B112"},"to":{"$ref":"B100"}},"why":"C1's input belt is empty; feed it the mined RuRuRuRu run so it can be cut"},{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B84"},"to":{"$ref":"H1","asCell":true}},"why":"deliver one cut half from the cutter to the hub so goal shapes arrive"}]}

{"say":"The recipe needs the mined four-quadrant shape cut in half, so I convert a segment of the miner-to-balancer belt runs in place into a cutter with the waste half trashed, letting the cut half continue on toward the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B64","B70","B82","B91","B98","B106"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"turn this mined-shape run into a cut line whose kept half keeps flowing downstream"},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B69","B81","B90","B97","B105"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"cut the parallel branch too so the merged balancer output is entirely the halved shape"}]}

{"say":"No fault is flagged yet, so I follow the recipe: cut the mined RuRuRuRu in the miner output line that feeds the balancer, sending the waste half to trash.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B90","B81"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"The mined RuRuRuRu run currently reaches the balancer uncut; converting a two-belt stretch of that run into cutter + trash performs the required cut step and dumps the unused half."}]}

{"say":"C1's feed line is dead (its balancer inputs have no sources), so I put a miner directly on the belt feeding the cutter, and also cut the live miner run that leads through the balancer chain to the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B100","asCell":true},"facing":"top","machine":"miner","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"B100 is the belt that feeds cutter C1 from a starved balancer; mining there restores ore into the already-wired cutter"},{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B105","asCell":true},"facing":"top","machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"cut the live miner run that continues up into the balancer chain toward the hub, so half shapes are delivered instead of whole ones"}]}
